symbol.title: Mathematics
symbol.desc: Geometry, a coordinate curve, and a tiled area connect shape, number, and change.

symbol.title: Computer science
symbol.desc: A branching decision tree joins a processor, logic paths, and stored information.

symbol.title: Physics
symbol.desc: A pendulum, oscillating wave, prism, and light rays depict motion and energy.

symbol.title: Chemistry
symbol.desc: A laboratory flask, bonded atoms, and a repeating crystal lattice show matter at several scales.

symbol.title: Biology
symbol.desc: A leaf with branching veins, a cell section, and a DNA double helix represent living organisation.

symbol.title: Earth and space
symbol.desc: Orbital paths, a terrestrial globe, and layered mountains connect planetary and geological scales.

symbol.title: Engineering
symbol.desc: A truss bridge, a mechanical gear, and a sectioned beam illustrate structure, motion, and design.

symbol.title: Architecture and design
symbol.desc: A perspective building, a drafting compass, and a floor plan connect space, construction, and proportion.

symbol.title: Environment and agriculture
symbol.desc: A rooted tree, soil layers, rain, and crop rows show connections within a living landscape.

symbol.title: Health
symbol.desc: Schematic heart and lung forms, a pulse trace, and a circular care motif introduce body systems and health.

symbol.title: Radiology
symbol.desc: A schematic scanner and patient table sit beside image slices and a reconstructed volume.

symbol.title: History
symbol.desc: An amphora, a manuscript scroll, and a stepped timeline represent material and written traces of the past.

symbol.title: Mind and society
symbol.desc: A schematic brain, branching neural connections, and a circle of people connect thought and social life.

symbol.title: Business and economics
symbol.desc: Exchange routes, a market chart, and stacked coins depict trade, production, and measurement.

symbol.title: Law and civics
symbol.desc: A civic building, balanced scales, and a ballot represent institutions, deliberation, and participation.

symbol.title: Education
symbol.desc: An open book grows a branching tree of ideas alongside geometric learning objects.

symbol.title: Language and literature
symbol.desc: A quill, ruled manuscript pages, and connected speech forms suggest writing, dialogue, and interpretation.

symbol.title: Arts
symbol.desc: A string instrument, painter's palette, brush, and musical staff connect sound and visual expression.

symbol.title: Communication and media
symbol.desc: A camera lens, sound waves, and a printed page show how information is captured and shared.
